About the clinic

A neighbourhood clinic with a modern chair.

Dr. M. N. Rahman's clinic is a private practice where you are seen in a calm, uncrowded setting instead of a busy hospital corridor. The treatment rooms are equipped with a full dental unit and bright overhead lighting, so work is precise and comfortable.

Every visit begins with a conversation. You hear what is going on in your mouth, what the options are and what each one involves, then decide together.

  • Clear explanationsPlain language, no pressure, no surprises.
  • Gentle handsCare that respects nervous patients and little ones.
  • Modern optionsFrom tooth-coloured fillings to invisible aligners.

FAQ

Questions people ask first.

Will my treatment hurt?
The aim is a comfortable visit. Numbing is used where needed, and you can raise a hand to pause at any time. Tell us beforehand if you are nervous and we will go at your pace.
What happens at a first visit?
We talk about your concerns and history, examine your teeth and gums, and take an X-ray only if it is needed. You then hear what we found and the options available, with costs, before anything is started.
How do clear aligners work?
Aligners are a series of clear, removable trays that move teeth gradually. After an assessment we explain whether they suit your teeth, how long treatment may take and what it costs.
How often should I get a check-up?
Most people do well with a check-up and clean every six months. If you have gum problems or are wearing aligners, we may suggest more frequent visits.
Can I bring my child?
Yes. A short, friendly first visit helps children get used to the clinic. Message us with your child's age and we will suggest the best time.
How do I book an appointment?
Tap any Book button or use the form below. It opens WhatsApp with your message ready to send, and the clinic will confirm a time with you there.
